#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int ind;
    long long val;
    Node(int i, long long v) : ind(i), val(v) {}
};

static int gcd(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

static int bsearch(const vector<long long>& list, long long val, int ind) {
    int l = ind, r = (int)list.size() - 1;
    int res = (int)list.size();
    while (l <= r) {
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (list[mid] > val) {
            if (mid == 0) {
                return mid;
            }
            if (list[mid - 1] <= val) {
                return mid;
            }
            r = mid - 1;
        } else {
            l = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

static long long calc(vector<Node>& list, vector<long long>& b, int i) {
    if (i == 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    Node first = list[i];
    int bInd = first.ind - 1;
    if (bInd == -1) bInd = 2;

    long long min1 = std::min(first.val, b[bInd]);
    first.val -= min1;
    b[bInd] -= min1;

    long long min2 = std::min(first.val, b[first.ind]);
    first.val -= min2;
    b[first.ind] -= min2;
    long long sum = first.val;
    sum += calc(list, b, i + 1);
    first.val += min1 + min2;
    b[bInd] += min1;
    b[first.ind] += min2;

    // second scenario
    first = list[i];
    bInd = first.ind - 1;
    if (bInd == -1) bInd = 2;

    min1 = std::min(first.val, b[first.ind]);
    first.val -= min1;
    b[first.ind] -= min1;

    min2 = std::min(first.val, b[bInd]);
    first.val -= min2;
    b[bInd] -= min2;
    long long sum2 = first.val;
    sum2 += calc(list, b, i + 1);
    first.val += min1 + min2;
    b[bInd] += min2;
    b[first.ind] += min1;

    return std::min(sum, sum2);
}

        ans << min_val << " " << max_val << "\n";
